$comment: Template only. Copy to config/trade-config.local.json (gitignored) and fill it in yourself. Every account you list is YOUR attestation that it belongs to that service: this project never ships or curates bot lists.

accounts.name: <bot account name>
accounts.$comment: id = the numeric MTGO user id (TradeWatch logs it as partnerId). A known id is authoritative: the account is matched by id and a different id using this name is refused. id null means name-only: refused unless allowNameOnlyAccounts is true, and then pinned to the first id seen with that name (config/trust-pins.local.json), so later trades are matched by id.
